title: ID0409903-DC/Si-D/FI-[LIjq41] Plugit- Dispenser left ccs2 cable gland failure
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
User reported that one of the charging cable is broken and separate wires are visible.
Solution:
Techician visit on-site and found out that the dispenser cable gland has failed 28.2.2025

Troubleshooting
: Please arrange for a site intervention to check for any loose connections at that specific outlet. If any wire is found to be loose, kindly pull the DC cable from outside and tighten the cable gland using the appropriate tool. Ensure that the DC cable is securely fixed and does not move inside the cable gland.
